_doc: Hand-curated overrides for scripts/build_stage_params.py. set_key_stages REPLACES the scan result for matching keys (fnmatch patterns, applied in order, later wins); key_to_stages adds; remove_key_stage removes a stage from a key unless it is the key's last stage; cross_cutting keys are listed as unattributed with the reason (read by every stage or at engine start); unattributed gives reasons for keys the scan cannot place. prompt_to_stages: first matching pattern (on the prompt id) wins; extra_prompts lists prompts defined in code, not in prompts/defaults.

cross_cutting.isolation.*: cross-cutting: scope and viewer isolation is enforced at every read and write door, not in one stage
cross_cutting.integrity.enabled: cross-cutting master switch for the trust model (A11, A14, C18, C20, C25)
cross_cutting.cache.*: generic cache backend (memory, lmdb, redis) shared by the embedding and read-result caches; no single stage owns it
cross_cutting.consent.local_hosts: cross-cutting: egress policy for every remote model call
cross_cutting.consent.remote_llm_max_tier: cross-cutting: egress policy for every remote model call
cross_cutting.data_shape.*: profile selector: resolves to preset keys at config load, no stage reads it
cross_cutting.data_profile: profile selector: resolves to preset keys at config load, no stage reads it
cross_cutting.profile: config template name, read at config load only
cross_cutting.strict_services: engine start-up check (missing service raises or skips), not a stage knob
cross_cutting.plugins: plug-in pinning at engine start, not a stage knob
cross_cutting.memories.*: per-memory-type enablement and policy overrides, resolved at engine start
cross_cutting.namespaces.*: per-namespace policy overrides, resolved at engine start
cross_cutting.model.llm.*.provider: role binding (provider, model, endpoint, timeout, no_think): applies to every LLM stage that uses the role; see each stage's prompts and models lists
cross_cutting.model.llm.*.settings: role binding (provider, model, endpoint, timeout, no_think): applies to every LLM stage that uses the role; see each stage's prompts and models lists
cross_cutting.model.llm.*.timeout_s: role binding (provider, model, endpoint, timeout, no_think): applies to every LLM stage that uses the role; see each stage's prompts and models lists
cross_cutting.model.llm.*.thinking: capped thinking budget of the judge / reflect role: applies to every stage that calls that role
cross_cutting.model.extraction.*: per-consumer GLiNER slots (semantic, prepass, topic, sensitivity); identical effective settings minus per-consumer fields share weights and each Engine owns its resources
cross_cutting.model.llm.*.escalation: opt-in per-chat-invocation model escalation over inline LLM target slots with explicit triggers, attempt limit, total deadline and per-attempt output setting; each candidate retains consent gates
cross_cutting.model.placement.thinking: capped thinking budget of a judge / reflect role the tier plan picks (an explicit slot uses model.llm.<role>.thinking): applies to every stage that calls that role
cross_cutting.model.placement.max_loaded_models: explicit bound on resident engine-owned GLiNER checkpoints; different slots may use different checkpoints within this resource cap
cross_cutting.model.placement.*: model planning at engine start (tiers, GPU placement, pins); applies to every stage that uses a model role
cross_cutting.prompts.*: prompt layout and override selection: applies to every engine prompt, see each stage's prompts list
cross_cutting.observability.*: wiretap, ops ledger, timers and inspect switches: they observe every stage, they do not change one
cross_cutting.rest.*: REST server (auth, rate limit): outside the memory pipeline
cross_cutting.runtime.*: scheduler, backpressure and concurrency budgets: apply to the whole engine, not to one stage
cross_cutting.storage.encryption.*: at-rest encryption of the SQLite file: applies to every stage that persists
cross_cutting.storage.profile: embedded vs server storage preset: applies to every stage that persists
cross_cutting.vector.namespace_index: vector-store layout, shared by A13 and every vector leg

cli_effect.--decider-backend: Inference backend (torch or onnx) of the opendecider model that picks the read mode.
cli_effect.--decider-device: Device the opendecider model runs on (cpu, cuda, mps, auto).
cli_effect.--decider-dtype: Weight dtype of the opendecider model (float32 or bfloat16).
cli_effect.--decider-min-confidence: Below this confidence the decider defers to the heuristic mode choice.
cli_effect.--decider-model: Checkpoint of the opendecider model used when --decider opendecider.
cli_effect.--top-k: Records the memory system returns per question (retrieval depth handed to the budget).
cli_effect.--base-url: OpenAI-compatible endpoint serving the reader (and judge) model.
cli_effect.--reader-model: Model that answers the question from the retrieved context.
cli_effect.--judge-model: Model that grades the answer; unset falls back to the reader model.
cli_effect.--max-model-calls: Hard cap on reader and judge calls in one run (stops the run when reached).
cli_effect.--mode: retrieval = score retrieval only, qa = also run reader and judge.
cli_effect.--note: Free-text note stored in the run manifest.
cli_effect.--run-id: Name of the run directory; unset derives one from the clock.
cli_effect.--with-memspine: Include the MemSpine system among the systems under test.
